name: BannerDesign - Default (seed v1)
description: A reusable banner, built like a Minecraft banner: a base colour plus pattern layers. Used by clans and ad-hoc siege teams, and shown on siege objectives.

steps.description: Name the banner and pick its background colour.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Identifies the banner when you pick one for a clan or a siege team; players don't see it. Up to 100 characters.

fields.label: Base colour
fields.description: Background dye colour of the banner, under every layer.

steps.description: The patterns on top of the base colour, drawn bottom to top. Save the banner first (Submit), then open it again to add layers.

fields.label: Layers
fields.description: Create New opens the layer form (pattern, colour, order); each layer is saved on its own. At most 16; more than 6 can't be made in a survival loom.
